migrations.name: 0001_initial_data_foundation.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Penny core data foundation. This migration is immutable once released.
-- It holds the durable records required by the initial real data spine; feature
-- behaviour, routes, and external adapters arrive in later migrations.

CREATE TABLE operators (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE operator_sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_used_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX operator_sessions_operator_id_idx ON operator_sessions(operator_id);

CREATE TABLE accounts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  internal_owner_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  revenue_cents INTEGER,
  renewal_date TEXT,
  health TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE requesters (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  blocked_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE requester_addresses (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  verified_at TEXT,
  suppressed_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX requester_addresses_requester_id_idx ON requester_addresses(requester_id);

CREATE TABLE requester_account_links (
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (requester_id, account_id)
);

CREATE TABLE boards (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('public', 'internal')),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  archived_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tags (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE evidence_items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  source_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_label TEXT,
  account_id TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id),
  requester_id TEXT REFERENCES requesters(id),
  recorded_by_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  review_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (review_state IN ('unreviewed', 'reviewed')),
  review_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX evidence_items_account_observed_idx ON evidence_items(account_id, observed_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX evidence_items_review_state_idx ON evidence_items(review_state);

CREATE TABLE evidence_versions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  wording TEXT NOT NULL,
  edited_by_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(evidence_id, version_number)
);

CREATE TABLE evidence_tag_assignments (
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (evidence_id, tag_id)
);

CREATE TABLE requests (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  board_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id),
  author_requester_id TEXT REFERENCES requesters(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  proposed_solution TEXT,
  impact_statement TEXT,
  moderation_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (moderation_state IN ('awaiting_review', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  public_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (public_state IN ('unpublished', 'open', 'under_review', 'planned', 'in_progress', 'shipped', 'declined', 'withdrawn')),
  public_title TEXT,
  public_description TEXT,
  published_at TEXT,
  declined_reason TEXT,
  withdrawn_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX requests_board_public_state_idx ON requests(board_id, public_state);

CREATE TABLE request_evidence_links (
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (request_id, evidence_id)
);

CREATE TABLE request_tag_assignments (
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (request_id, tag_id)
);

CREATE TABLE request_votes (
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (request_id, requester_id)
);

CREATE TABLE request_comments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  requester_id TEXT REFERENCES requesters(id),
  operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  moderation_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (moderation_state IN ('awaiting_review', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  published_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((requester_id IS NOT NULL AND operator_id IS NULL) OR (requester_id IS NULL AND operator_id IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE request_follows (
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  permission_granted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  muted_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (request_id, requester_id)
);

CREATE TABLE attachments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  request_id TEXT REFERENCES requests(id),
  evidence_id TEXT REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  storage_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  public_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (public_state IN ('operator_only', 'published', 'rejected')),
  rejection_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((request_id IS NOT NULL AND evidence_id IS NULL) OR (request_id IS NULL AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE decisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  question TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft', 'ready', 'committed', 'review_due')),
  owner_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  confidence TEXT CHECK (confidence IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')),
  review_at TEXT,
  selected_candidate_bet_id TEXT,
  rationale TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX decisions_state_review_at_idx ON decisions(state, review_at);

CREATE TABLE candidate_bets (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  decision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES decisions(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  urgency TEXT,
  delivery_shape TEXT,
  success_measure TEXT,
  assumptions TEXT,
  counter_evidence TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX candidate_bets_decision_id_idx ON candidate_bets(decision_id);

CREATE TABLE candidate_bet_account_links (
  candidate_bet_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES candidate_bets(id),
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (candidate_bet_id, account_id)
);

CREATE TABLE candidate_bet_evidence_links (
  candidate_bet_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES candidate_bets(id),
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  stance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stance IN ('supporting', 'contradicting')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (candidate_bet_id, evidence_id)
);

CREATE TABLE decision_revisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  decision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES decisions(id),
  revision_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  selected_candidate_bet_id TEXT REFERENCES candidate_bets(id),
  rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
  confidence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (confidence IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')),
  review_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  no_viable_alternative_reason TEXT,
  committed_by_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(decision_id, revision_number)
);

CREATE TABLE decision_evidence_snapshots (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  decision_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES decision_revisions(id),
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  evidence_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_versions(id),
  candidate_bet_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES candidate_bets(id),
  stance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stance IN ('supporting', 'contradicting')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE roadmap_items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  decision_id TEXT REFERENCES decisions(id),
  candidate_bet_id TEXT REFERENCES candidate_bets(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('exploring', 'planned', 'in_progress', 'shipped', 'dropped')),
  target_window TEXT,
  delivery_notes TEXT,
  confidence TEXT CHECK (confidence IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX roadmap_items_status_idx ON roadmap_items(status);

CREATE TABLE roadmap_transitions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  roadmap_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roadmap_items(id),
  from_status TEXT,
  to_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (to_status IN ('exploring', 'planned', 'in_progress', 'shipped', 'dropped')),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE roadmap_publications (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  roadmap_item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES roadmap_items(id),
  public_title TEXT NOT NULL,
  public_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  approved_by_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  approved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  withdrawn_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE roadmap_request_mappings (
  roadmap_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roadmap_items(id),
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES requests(id),
  approved_at TEXT,
  withdrawn_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (roadmap_item_id, request_id)
);

CREATE TABLE releases (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft', 'published')),
  current_version_id TEXT,
  author_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  published_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE release_versions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES releases(id),
  version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  release_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (release_type IN ('new', 'improved', 'fixed')),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  publication_date TEXT,
  setup_url TEXT,
  outcome_prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject_tags_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_portal_current INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_portal_current IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(release_id, version_number)
);

CREATE TABLE release_targets (
  release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES releases(id),
  roadmap_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roadmap_items(id),
  decision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES decisions(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (release_id, roadmap_item_id)
);

CREATE TABLE release_recipient_snapshots (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  release_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES release_versions(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  requester_address_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requester_addresses(id),
  request_id TEXT REFERENCES requests(id),
  evidence_id TEXT REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(release_version_id, requester_id)
);

CREATE TABLE release_outcomes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  release_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES release_versions(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  roadmap_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roadmap_items(id),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('adopted', 'partly_adopted', 'not_yet')),
  revision_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(release_version_id, requester_id, roadmap_item_id, revision_number)
);

CREATE TABLE custom_field_definitions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  field_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(entity_type, name)
);

CREATE TABLE custom_field_values (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  definition_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_field_definitions(id),
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(definition_id, entity_id)
);

CREATE TABLE audit_entries (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('operator', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  entity_id TEXT,
  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  details_json TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX audit_entries_entity_idx ON audit_entries(entity_type, entity_id, occurred_at DESC);

migrations.name: 0002_native_feedback_baseline.sql
0003_opaque_native_request_slugs.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Repair content-derived URLs in unreleased native submissions. Curated/public
-- Stage 0 records keep their approved existing URLs. Native IDs/history survive.
UPDATE requests SET slug = 'feedback-' || lower(id)
WHERE id IN (SELECT request_id FROM request_submission_keys);

migrations.name: 0004_archive_erasure_fences.sql
0005_requester_board.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Penny request lifecycle. Requester authentication material lives in 0002_auth
-- and operator notification delivery lives in 0003_operator.

ALTER TABLE requests ADD COLUMN merged_into_request_id TEXT REFERENCES requests(id);
ALTER TABLE requests ADD COLUMN merged_at TEXT;
ALTER TABLE evidence_items ADD COLUMN withdrawn_at TEXT;
ALTER TABLE request_comments ADD COLUMN rejection_reason TEXT;
ALTER TABLE request_comments ADD COLUMN edited_at TEXT;

CREATE INDEX requests_merged_into_idx ON requests(merged_into_request_id);

CREATE TABLE request_content_submissions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  proposed_solution TEXT,
  impact_statement TEXT,
  moderation_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (moderation_state IN ('awaiting_review', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  rejection_reason TEXT,
  approved_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX request_content_submissions_request_state_idx
  ON request_content_submissions(request_id, moderation_state, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE request_comment_edits (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  comment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES request_comments(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  moderation_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (moderation_state IN ('awaiting_review', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  rejection_reason TEXT,
  approved_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX request_comment_edits_comment_state_idx
  ON request_comment_edits(comment_id, moderation_state, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE request_moderation_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('request', 'request_edit', 'comment', 'comment_edit', 'attachment')),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('approved', 'rejected')),
  reason TEXT,
  actor_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX request_moderation_events_request_idx ON request_moderation_events(request_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE request_moderation_appeals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('request', 'request_edit', 'comment', 'comment_edit')),
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open', 'reviewed')),
  reviewed_by_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  reviewed_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX request_moderation_appeals_request_state_idx ON request_moderation_appeals(request_id, state, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE request_status_updates (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  public_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (public_status IN ('open', 'under_review', 'planned', 'in_progress', 'shipped', 'declined')),
  previous_public_state TEXT,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  pinned INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pinned IN (0, 1)),
  operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  published_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX request_status_updates_request_published_idx ON request_status_updates(request_id, published_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE request_notes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX request_notes_request_idx ON request_notes(request_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE requester_pending_actions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  pending_token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  action_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action_type IN ('submission', 'vote', 'follow', 'comment')),
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  claimed_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(pending_token_hash, action_type)
);

CREATE INDEX requester_pending_actions_expiry_idx ON requester_pending_actions(expires_at, claimed_at);

CREATE TABLE requester_update_permissions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  requester_address_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requester_addresses(id),
  request_id TEXT REFERENCES requests(id),
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('submission', 'vote', 'follow', 'subscription')),
  granted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX requester_update_permissions_requester_idx ON requester_update_permissions(requester_id, requester_address_id, revoked_at, granted_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE request_merges (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  source_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  target_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),
  actor_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  merged_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  unmerged_at TEXT,
  unmerged_by_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (source_request_id != target_request_id)
);

CREATE INDEX request_merges_target_active_idx ON request_merges(target_request_id, unmerged_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX request_merges_active_source_idx ON request_merges(source_request_id) WHERE unmerged_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE request_merge_evidence_transfers (
  merge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES request_merges(id),
  evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_items(id),
  target_was_linked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_was_linked IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (merge_id, evidence_id)
);

CREATE TABLE request_merge_vote_transfers (
  merge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES request_merges(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  target_had_vote INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_had_vote IN (0, 1)),
  source_created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (merge_id, requester_id)
);

CREATE TABLE request_merge_follow_transfers (
  merge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES request_merges(id),
  requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  target_had_follow INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_had_follow IN (0, 1)),
  source_permission_granted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_muted_at TEXT,
  source_created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (merge_id, requester_id)
);

CREATE TABLE request_merge_comment_transfers (
  merge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES request_merges(id),
  comment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES request_comments(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE request_merge_attachment_transfers (
  merge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES request_merges(id),
  attachment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attachments(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE requester_identity_merges (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  source_requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  target_requester_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requesters(id),
  actor_operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (source_requester_id != target_requester_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX requester_identity_merges_source_idx ON requester_identity_merges(source_requester_id);

-- Public attribution is an approved snapshot. Public readers never derive it
-- from a current requester or operator identity.

ALTER TABLE requests ADD COLUMN public_author_display_name TEXT;
ALTER TABLE request_comments ADD COLUMN public_author_display_name TEXT;
ALTER TABLE request_comments ADD COLUMN public_author_kind TEXT CHECK (public_author_kind IN ('requester', 'operator'));

-- Existing published records predate the snapshot columns. This one-time
-- migration preserves their then-current explicit publication attribution;
-- future publications set snapshots through moderation writes.
UPDATE requests
SET public_author_display_name = approved_author_name
WHERE moderation_state = 'approved'
  AND published_at IS NOT NULL
  AND author_requester_id IS NOT NULL;

UPDATE request_comments
SET public_author_display_name = CASE
      WHEN requester_id IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT requester.display_name FROM requesters requester WHERE requester.id = request_comments.requester_id)
      ELSE (SELECT operator.display_name FROM operators operator WHERE operator.id = request_comments.operator_id)
    END,
    public_author_kind = CASE WHEN requester_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'requester' ELSE 'operator' END
WHERE moderation_state = 'approved'
  AND published_at IS NOT NULL;

-- A held portal action may replay only through the requester verification link
-- that was issued for it. The value is the existing one-way pending-token hash;
-- raw browser tokens and requester addresses are never persisted here.
ALTER TABLE native_magic_links ADD COLUMN pending_token_hash TEXT;

-- The first email-verification request binds the browser token to that
-- recipient for the whole 24-hour hold window. This HMAC is derived from
-- AUTH_SECRET; no plaintext address is copied into a pending-action record.
CREATE TABLE requester_pending_action_bindings (
  pending_token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  verification_email_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX requester_pending_action_bindings_expires_idx
  ON requester_pending_action_bindings(expires_at);

CREATE TABLE notification_outbox (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  requester_id TEXT REFERENCES requesters(id),
  operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id),
  dedupe_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (delivery_state IN ('queued', 'accepted', 'delivered', 'failed', 'suppressed', 'unknown')),
  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  available_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  failure_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX notification_outbox_delivery_idx ON notification_outbox(delivery_state, available_at);
CREATE INDEX notification_outbox_requester_idx ON notification_outbox(requester_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX notification_outbox_operator_idx ON notification_outbox(operator_id, created_at DESC);

-- 0005's journal cannot prove an old source vote survived removal followed by a
-- new canonical vote. A strictly newer current creation time disproves it.

-- and is preserved rather than inventing evidence of a removal.

WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM request_merges m JOIN request_merge_vote_transfers t ON t.merge_id=m.id
 JOIN request_canonical_roots root ON root.origin_id=m.source_request_id

 WHERE m.unmerged_at IS NULL AND m.source_request_id=c.request_id AND t.requester_id=c.requester_id

-- Retained withdrawn/unpublished lifecycle states outrank an old mapping.
DROP VIEW penny_request_status;
CREATE VIEW penny_request_status AS
 WITH mapped AS (
 SELECT r.id AS request_id,r.public_state,r.latest_status_source,r.direct_status_changed_at,r.mapped_status_changed_at,
  i.status AS roadmap_status,s.name AS internal_name,s.show_public_label,s.public_status AS internal_public_status
 FROM requests r LEFT JOIN request_internal_statuses s ON s.id=r.internal_status_id
 LEFT JOIN roadmap_request_mappings m ON m.request_id=r.id AND m.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND m.withdrawn_at IS NULL
 LEFT JOIN roadmap_publications p ON p.roadmap_item_id=m.roadmap_item_id AND p.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND p.withdrawn_at IS NULL
  AND (p.board_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM boards b WHERE b.id=p.board_id AND b.visibility='public' AND b.archived_at IS NULL))
 LEFT JOIN roadmap_items i ON i.id=p.roadmap_item_id AND i.status!='dropped'
 ), resolved AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN public_state NOT IN ('declined','withdrawn','unpublished') AND latest_status_source='roadmap' AND roadmap_status IS NOT NULL THEN 'roadmap' ELSE 'direct' END AS source FROM mapped
 )
 SELECT request_id,source,
 CASE WHEN source='roadmap' THEN CASE WHEN roadmap_status='exploring' THEN 'under_review' ELSE roadmap_status END ELSE public_state END AS status,
 CASE WHEN source='roadmap' THEN mapped_status_changed_at ELSE direct_status_changed_at END AS changed_at,
 CASE WHEN source='direct' AND show_public_label=1 AND internal_public_status=public_state THEN internal_name END AS public_label
 FROM resolved;
